review.shorterRoute: The exact j-germ order already bounds the original analytic ramification by the full modular stabilizer. Native E4/E6 isolated-zero results therefore give ramification one on punctured neighborhoods. At an unramified center, shift the actual residue family and apply the existing generic inverse-function parameter theorem. This avoids a new inverse-function argument and postpones stabilizer identification to the elliptic centers that actually require it.
assumptionsToDischarge: One common neighborhood has normalized orders for every actual field element around any unramified analytic center.
Actual residue evaluation of the original uniformizer supplies an injective local chart, with no assumed parameter family or order model.
The unramified hypothesis is derived at every center with E4 and E6 nonzero.
